title: Time-lapse Killing Assay Using IncuCyte
author: Philippa R Kennedy
materials: Option 1: Target cells are labeled using an amine-reactive dye (CellTrace Far Red Proliferation Kit, Cat. No:C34564, Thermo Fisher) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

Option 2: Target cells are stably transduced with a red fluorescent protein (IncuCyte NucLight Red Lentiviral Reagent - EF1α Puro, Cat. No. 4625, Essen Bioscience) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

Option 3: Target cells are stably transfected with a green fluorescent protein (GFP). In this situation, a red cell death indicator should be used (IncuCyte Caspase 3/7 Red Apoptosis Assay Reagent, Cat. No. 4704, Essen BioScience).
Optional: An indicator of cell death is added to the media (1/1000 dilution; IncuCyte Caspase-3/7 Green Apoptosis Assay reagent, Cat. No:4440, Essen BioScience).

Image analysis is performed in the Incucyte software. Live targets (Target cell fluorescence+ Caspase3/7-) are detected at each time point. The percentage of live targets at any given time point is normalized for the number of live targets in each well at the starting time point (t = 0 h), and further normalized to the growth of targets growing alone. This data is then plotted in GraphPad Prism.

steps.title: Prepare Target Cells
steps.instruction: Fluorescently label target cells to differentiate them from effector cells.

steps.title: Plate Target Cells
steps.instruction: Plate labeled target cells in a monolayer in a 96 well flat-bottom plate (Cat. No: 353072, Corning) in 100 μL volume.

substeps.instruction: For non-adherent cells, use plates pre-coated with 0.01% poly-L-ornithine (Cat. No. A-004-C, Fisher Scientific) for 2 h at room temperature.
Leave plates untouched for 10 min at room temperature after plating to ensure an even monolayer.
Allow adherent targets to adhere overnight.
Titrate cell numbers for each target, generally using 2 x 10^4 cells/well for suspension cells and 1 x 10^4 cells/well for adherent cells.

steps.title: Capture Baseline Image
steps.instruction: Take a 'targets alone' image prior to the addition of effectors to normalize live targets per well.

steps.title: Add Effector Cells and Drugs
steps.instruction: Add enriched NK cells and any required drugs to the target cell monolayer, bringing the final volume to 200 μL.

substeps.instruction: Use a 2:1 effector:target ratio (adjust ratio if necessary based on target cell sensitivity and natural cytotoxicity).

steps.title: Perform Time-lapse Imaging
steps.instruction: Incubate plates in an incubator equipped with a time-lapse microscope (IncuCyte Zoom or S3, Sartorius Inc.) with 4x, 10x and 20x lenses for 48 hours.
